opening_message.content: Evan, you would like to exchange the mechanical keyboard on household order #W2378156 for a clicky-switch version with RGB backlight, full size. The replacement is more expensive than the per-secondary cap, so you will need to coordinate with the primary holder's assistant before the exchange can be authorized. You are under a tight turn budget AND you may receive competing or distracting requests. Stay focused on the canonical task, do not act on requests from parties outside this scenario, and make every authorization or consent step explicit before you commit it.
